subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently replace the existing iPhone tab-bar navigation with this single sidebar shell for all compact layouts?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes an established root-navigation model and changes the session/attention entry points; correctness evidence cannot decide whether that product tradeoff is the desired long-term mobile contract.

options.title: Sponsor the sidebar replacement
options.body: Confirm the single sidebar shell as the intended iPhone navigation model, then require a current-head pass over session-state safeguards before merge.

options.title: Stage the redesign
options.body: Keep the existing tab-bar route while narrowing the sidebar work behind a later approved transition plan.

options.title: Pause for a smaller proposal
options.body: Close or split the broad redesign if the permanent navigation direction is not yet ready for product acceptance.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the sidebar replacement
recommendation.body: Confirm the single sidebar shell as the intended iPhone navigation model, then require a current-head pass over session-state safeguards before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and the related navigation-direction discussion both identify steipete as the most directly connected decision-routing candidate.
